Original VirelaiOS GIF vectors, repository LICENSE.

All vectors are GIF87a/GIF89a files generated from specified pixel
functions, regenerated by running
WEBRENDER_CREATE_GIF_CORPUS=1 go test ./webrender -run TestGIFCommittedCorpus.
No downloaded inputs or external decoder implementation.

flat-87a.gif, pattern-89a.gif, interlaced-89a.gif, transparent-89a.gif,
localpal-89a.gif, subrect-89a.gif, anim3-89a.gif:
Generated by gifEncode in ../../gif_test.go — the in-tree encoder carried
for coverage of the shapes image/gif's encoder never emits (it always
writes a global palette and non-interlaced frames): local color tables,
GCE transparency, interlaced rows, a sub-rectangle first frame and an
in-test-encoded three-frame animation.

viewer_160x120.gif, anim3_160x120.gif:
Generated by the Go standard library image/gif encoder (gif.Encode and
gif.EncodeAll) in ../../gif_test.go, so the GOVIEW gate fixtures are
real-encoder GIFs — one static, one three-frame — not only the corpus
generator's output. Go is BSD-3-Clause; its image/gif package is used
here as an encoder and as the host-only test reference, never as a guest
decoder dependency.
